summary: The diff implements Date.prototype.getDate in its own file and follows the five spec steps in order. Step 2 (RequireInternalSlot) is delegated to `date::this_time_value(agent, this)?`, which propagates errors with `?`. Step 4 returns NaN when the time value is NaN. Step 5 returns `date_from_time(local_time(agent, tv))` as a Number. There are no test-shaped branches, no swallowed errors, and no made-up values. The only changes outside the spec steps are renaming the unused `args` and `new_target` parameters to `_args` and `_new_target`, which is needed to avoid unused-variable warnings now that the old `let _ = ...` line is gone. I did not inspect the `support::date` helpers themselves, so the claim that `this_time_value` performs RequireInternalSlot with a TypeError is unverified from this diff alone.
